/bin/bash -lc "cd .tmp && cat > analyze2.py << 'EOF'
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

img = np.array(Image.open(\"../first_frame.png\").convert(\"RGB\"))
h, w, _ = img.shape
R, G, B = img[...,0].astype(int), img[...,1].astype(int), img[...,2].astype(int)

# Orange tangerine: R high, R > G > B distinctly
orange = (R > 180) & (G > 90) & (G < 200) & (B < 120) & (R - B > 80)
print(\"orange pixels:\", orange.sum())
ys, xs = np.nonzero(orange)
if len(xs):
    print(\"x range\", xs.min(), xs.max(), \"y range\", ys.min(), ys.max())
    print(\"centroid\", round(xs.mean(),1), round(ys.mean(),1))

# Strong orange (peel)
strong = (R > 200) & (R - B > 110)
print(\"strong orange:\", strong.sum())
ys, xs = np.nonzero(strong)
if len(xs):
    print(\"strong x\", xs.min(), xs.max(), \"y\", ys.min(), ys.max(), \"centroid\", round(xs.mean(),1), round(ys.mean(),1))

# brightest / whitest (glass highlights?)
bright = (R > 200) & (G > 200) & (B > 200)
print(\"near-white:\", bright.sum())
ys, xs = np.nonzero(bright)
if len(xs):
    print(\"white x\", xs.min(), xs.max(), \"y\", ys.min(), ys.max())

# dark pixels (knife?)
dark = (R < 70) & (G < 70) & (B < 70)
print(\"dark:\", dark.sum())
ys, xs = np.nonzero(dark)
if len(xs):
    print(\"dark x\", xs.min(), xs.max(), \"y\", ys.min(), ys.max(), \"centroid\", round(xs.mean(),1), round(ys.mean(),1))

# Row/col profiles of orange
colsum = orange.sum(axis=0)
rowsum = orange.sum(axis=1)
print(\"\\norange col profile (x:count) nonzero:\")
runs = []
inrun = False
for x, v in enumerate(colsum):
    if v > 0 and not inrun:
        start = x; inrun = True
    if (v == 0 or x == w-1) and inrun:
        runs.append((start, x-1)); inrun = False
print(runs)
print(\"\\norange row runs:\")
runs = []
inrun = False
for y, v in enumerate(rowsum):
    if v > 0 and not inrun:
        start = y; inrun = True
    if (v == 0 or y == h-1) and inrun:
        runs.append((start, y-1)); inrun = False
print(runs)
EOF
python analyze2.py"
